text:
Maya: quick summary from today's Harborline onboarding call  they logged a few product asks and one potential renewal concern. raw notes in drive linked.
Liam: can you drop the top priority issues here so we can triage?
Maya: top things: 1) search embeddings returning vendor labels instead of SKUs (impacts commerce lookup) 2) per-route billing examples in docs are ambiguous  customer thought quota was global 3) request for team-level quotas + admin UI to manage them. Also doc snippet uses `route_name` but our SDK now expects `path`.
Jordan: for #1, any minimal repro (query + response) we can paste?
Maya: pasted below and uploaded transcript: https://app.redwood/meetings/harborline-2026-05-03/transcript 
Maya: ```
query: "what is the sku for red nozzle"
response: "Red Nozzle (by FlowGoods)"  // missing SKU token e.g. SKU-12345
```
Ava: flagged as a quarterly renewal account. CSM said search reliability is a gating factor for expansion  marking as renewal-risk.
Liam: assigning owners  @Jordan can you reproduce today and mark whether it's prompt/preproc vs model answer distribution?
Jordan: will repro. if it's preproc/prompt we can push a fix in ~5 business days; model tuning or new model variant could be longer.
Maya: small docs fix (rename `route_name` -> `path` example) we can change right away.
Liam: action list: (1) Jordan triage embeddings (owner: Jordan) (2) Docs patch (owner: Liam) (3) Feature request for team quotas + admin UI (owner: Maya).
Maya: created ticket FEED-9009 and attached call notes: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-9009  please add labels `onboarding`, `search`, `billing` and estimates.
feedback-bot: FEED-9009 created and linked to Harborline. Priority: P2.
Ava: I'll reach out to Harborline with a temporary workaround (prompt hint to include SKU or a regex postprocess) and capture exact acceptance criteria.
Liam: please aim for a triage update by EOD tomorrow and a docs canary today.
Jordan: updating FEED-9009 with repro steps now, will post logs here after tests.
Maya: thanks all :+1:  I'll follow up with a 10m sync if Jordan's repro surfaces actionables before the CSM follow-up.
